 except Exception:pass

for h in [chr(39),chr(34),chr(92)]:q=q.replace(h,"")
def m(b):return any(h in b for h in "*?[") and fnmatch.fnmatchcase("codex",re.sub(r"\[[!^]?\]?[^\]]*\]","?",b))
D=set("[ ag basename cat cd cmp cp cut date declare df diff dirname du echo egrep export false fgrep file gh git grep head jq less ln local ls mkdir more mv pgrep printenv printf ps pwd readlink readonly realpath rg rm sed sleep sort stat tail tee test touch tr true type uniq unset wc whereis which yq".split())

 if "codex" not in q:return 0
 if chr(36) in q or chr(96) in q:return 1
 for s in re.split(r"[;&|()\n]+",q):
  w=s.split()
  while w and re.match(r"[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*\+?=",w[0]):
   if "codex" in w[0]:return 1
